pages.title: Before it
pages.note: Twelve photographs from villages in the Lebanese hills. Ordinary things, made while they were still there.

pieces.label: From the series
pieces.text: Most of what these photographs show is not rare. It is simply about to be gone.

pieces.note: A pine above the last turn of the village road.

pages.title: About the series
paras: Habib Saleh photographs and makes films. This series was made over two years, on visits to villages in Lebanon, in the light of ordinary afternoons.
The photographs are available as prints and as a short film.
